// diagnostic

L0106

Field `{type_name}.{name}` is never read.

What

Field `{type_name}.{name}` is never read.

Why

Code may write this field, but nothing reads it, so it carries data no part of the program uses. Printing, encoding, derived equality or ordering, reflection and foreign code count as reads; derived cloning does not.

Fix

Remove the field, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when it is intentional.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0106: Tests/UI/member_liveness_field_uses_clone.stderr.

Error [jet.UnreadField]: Field `Draft.notes` is never read.
  --> Tests/UI/member_liveness_field_uses_clone.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     notes: String,
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: Code may write this field, but nothing reads it, so it carries data no part of the program uses. Printing, encoding, derived equality or ordering, reflection and foreign code count as reads; derived cloning does not.
 Fix: Remove the field, or rename `notes` to `_notes` when it is intentional.
